name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
description: Direct income support of Rs. 6,000/year to eligible farmer families, paid in three equal instalments of Rs. 2,000 directly into bank accounts.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmer families (cultivable landholding) as per land records; excludes institutional landholders, higher-income categories.
benefits: Rs. 6,000 per year direct transfer; supports farm input costs.
application_mode: Online (pmkisan.gov.in), CSC, or nearest agriculture office
application_steps: Verify and submit; note registration number.
Instalments credited to bank account; check status online.
processing_time: Instalments released periodically; first credit after verification (weeks).
validity: Continuous while eligibility and land records valid; e-KYC required periodically.

faq.a: Commonly due to Aadhaar-bank seeding mismatch or pending e-KYC; complete e-KYC on the portal.
Benefit is linked to landholding records in the owner's name; tenant farmers are generally not separate beneficiaries.

ai_summary: PM-KISAN gives eligible farmer families Rs. 6,000/year in 3 DBT instalments; free, Aadhaar-linked.
ai_explanation: The scheme transfers Rs. 2,000 every four months to farmer families owning cultivable land, subject to exclusion criteria. Registration needs Aadhaar, a DBT bank account, and land records. Periodic e-KYC is mandatory to keep receiving benefits.
